gate_1_scaling_with_the_tolerance.claim: whether the stall reading's clean maximum scales with the solve's tolerance, in each dtype
gate_1_scaling_with_the_tolerance.case: probe/lines.py through ImplicitFlowNode (flag_cases.readings), the node's stall_ratio at every step

prediction.value: float64: the maxima scale with the tolerance, about 5e-7 (tight, 1e-9), 5.1e-6 (default, reproducing the table), 5e-5 (loose, 1e-7); the ratio loose/default in 3 to 12 and tight/default in 0.08 to 0.4. float32: the default reproduces 2.0e-3 (1.5e-3 to 2.5e-3) and the worst case does NOT scale: loose (1e-4) over nominal (explicit 1e-5) in 3 to 12 only where the tolerance is above the floor, but the maximum over the envelope is set by the draws whose rounding floor eps x tau/dt (1e-4 to 4e-4 at tau/dt 1e3 to 3e3) is above the tolerance, so tight (1e-6) over nominal in 0.7 to 1.5 and the default over nominal in 0.7 to 1.5
prediction.basis: derived: N_Krylov = dt rho <rhs - A u', u'> is the stop's true residual (relative tolerance times |rhs|) against the solution, and |rhs| |u'| over the viscous dissipation grows with tau/dt, so the reading is about tolerance x tau/dt x c where the solve stops at its tolerance; the CG checks every 20 iterations, so the stop overshoots the tolerance by a factor between 0.1 and 1 and the maximum is a fraction of the linear law. Float32 stops at max(tolerance, floor) by default and stagnates at the floor when a given tolerance is below it
prediction.why: float64's floor (eps x tau/dt, 7e-13 at 3e3) is orders below 1e-8, so every float64 run stops at its tolerance; float32's floor is above 1e-5 for tau/dt above about 80

gate_1_scaling_with_the_tolerance.metric: the per-run worst reading and the ratios of the 200-run maxima across tolerances

control.plant: the default arm reproduces the table's maxima (5.1e-6, 2.0e-3): the probe measures the same runs by the same code; a different default maximum would say the harness or the node moved since the table
control.expected_rate: default maxima within 1.5 times of the table's
control.clean_expected: no run with a non-finite reading

gate_1_scaling_with_the_tolerance.if_wrong: float64 not scaling would mean the stall reading is not set by the solve's stop and the rule's 'tie to the tolerance' has nothing to tie to; float32 scaling with the tolerance would mean its worst case is a tolerance-limited run, not a floor-limited one
gate_1_scaling_with_the_tolerance.cannot_discriminate_if: a tight float32 arm stops at a stagnation (below the floor) on every run: then it measures the floor, not the tolerance, and says nothing about scaling for tolerances the floor does not hide

prediction.value: one line a dtype, about twice the default arm's clean maximum: 1e-5 (float64) and 4e-3 (float32), the harness's present lines, so the node's 1e-3 moves to them (float64 down by 100, float32 up by 4); the node's flag no longer fires on correct float32 runs in the envelope
